title: Montjuic hill session (ran long, over cap)
terrain: Barcelona, Montjuic road/park climbs 5-8%; fallback hotel treadmill 8%
coachNotes:
DONE: 97min, 16.0km, 517m D+, avg 156bpm, max 183, RPE 7, icu load 115 vs 90 planned (+28%). 39min in Z4-Z5, 12.5min of it in Z5. Rep peaks 179-183bpm vs 165-172 band; last 4km fast and flat (4:36-5:06/km, up to 177bpm), not in the plan.
VERDICT: overcooked on an amber day. HRV 44 (2nd day under 50, baseline ~60), sleep 6.0h: the stop rule said 4 reps and a 168 cap. You did the full set plus a tempo finish. The fitness is there (sub-5 km on tired legs at the end),, but an amber-day quality session turned into a race.
REST OF DAY: walk only, no gym. 1L water + salt before the summit, carb-heavy lunch, no alcohol at the summit dinner, lights out 23:00.
KNOCK-ON: Wed cut to 50min Z2 at 138-148bpm, no strides (load 60 -> 50). Thu/Fri/Sat unchanged; Sat 2h30 stays the key session and is protected by Wed.
WHY: TSB -11 and ATL 62 with HRV suppressed 2 days. Week is still +15 on plan (576 vs 561), so nothing is lost by easing Wed.
